items.source: Returns a composed MongoRepositoryFragmentsContributor that first applies this contributor to its inputs, and then applies the after contributor concatenating effectively both results.
items.translation: 返回一个组合后的 MongoRepositoryFragmentsContributor，它首先将此贡献者应用于其输入，然后应用 after 贡献者，有效地将两者结果拼接在一起。

items.source: Configures the MongoRepositoryFragmentsContributor to be used.
Configures the MongoRepositoryFragmentsContributor to contribute built-in fragment functionality to the repository.
items.translation: 配置 MongoRepositoryFragmentsContributor，使其向仓库贡献内置片段功能。

items.source: Support infrastructure for query derivation of MongoDB specific repositories.
items.translation: 支持从 MongoDB 特定存储库推导查询的基础设施。
MongoRepositoryFragmentsContributor 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.support 包中的用途
